{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|Yes, it's amazing how those performers can sing for five hours straight. They must train their voices for years before they can carry out such a feat of musical daring.|[[Wendell Wright-Sims]], scrutinizing ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]''|<ref name="An Old Flame in Need...">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
[[File:Opera-MaraJadeByTheEmperorsHand2.png|thumb|right|250px|A performance of ''The Agony of Tarkin'', a Coruscanti opera]]
An '''opera''' was a theatrical work set to music and made up of vocal pieces with orchestral accompaniment. It was a form of music popular amongst [[Noble/Legends|socialites]] and was considered mind-improving,<ref name="RCTZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> while commoners often found it annoying.<ref name="XWIR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> [[Casino/Legends|Casino]] owner [[Jacc Mandelbrot]] was known to enjoy singing long stretches of opera in a deep, booming voice,<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself was an opera lover.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Famous operas included ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]''<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> and ''[[The Agony of Tarkin]]''.<ref name="BTEH">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref> Many cultures throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] produced their own brand of opera, from the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="COD" /> to the pig-like [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]<ref name="XWIR" /> and the amphibious [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="RCTZ" />

The term was also used as a metonymy to designate houses in which such dramas were performed, such as the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]]<ref name="COD" /> or the [[Jediboh Opera]].<ref name="SFG">{{SpaceFantasyGamerCite|88|Peekoine Opera Blues}}</ref>
